run_boot_dqn_single_experiment: run a bootstrapped DQN agent on a single bsuite environment like catch/0 and log results to CSV
run_boot_dqn_sweep: run a bootstrapped DQN agent across a sweep of bsuite experiments using MPI parallel execution
review_run_function: review the run function that creates a BootstrappedDQN agent with an ensemble network and executes it on a bsuite environment
review_main_function: review the main function that dispatches single experiments or multiprocess sweeps based on the bsuite_id flag
refactor_run_function: refactor the run function to support custom optimizer or ensemble hyperparameters beyond absl flags
